mutual_tls_enforced.title: Mutual TLS Enforced on Pipeline-to-Registry Channel
mutual_tls_enforced.description: Whether mutual TLS is fully enforced on the pipeline-to-registry connection, requiring both client certificate presentation and server certificate validation. Covers both the pipeline client configuration and registry server enforcement.

registry_transport_protocol.title: Registry Transport Protocol
registry_transport_protocol.description: The transport protocol used by the pipeline when communicating with the artifact registry or container registry during push operations.

minimum_tls_version.title: Minimum TLS Version
minimum_tls_version.description: The minimum TLS protocol version enforced for connections between the CI/CD pipeline and artifact registry/container registry endpoints.

deprecated_cipher_suites_enabled.title: Deprecated Cipher Suites Enabled
deprecated_cipher_suites_enabled.description: List of deprecated or weak cipher suites currently enabled in the TLS configuration for the pipeline-to-registry channel (e.g., RC4-SHA, DES-CBC3-SHA, AES128-CBC-SHA without AEAD).

tls_downgrade_protection_enabled.title: TLS Downgrade Protection Enabled
tls_downgrade_protection_enabled.description: Whether TLS downgrade attack protections (e.g., TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV) are enforced on the registry endpoint to prevent negotiation to weaker protocol versions.

tls_certificate_verification_enforced.title: TLS Certificate Verification Enforced
tls_certificate_verification_enforced.description: Whether the registry client enforces TLS certificate verification when connecting to the registry. When false, the client may accept self-signed or invalid certificates, enabling downgrade attacks or connections to rogue endpoints. Also covers http_fallback_enabled conditions when false.

registry_credential_scope.title: Registry Credential Scope
registry_credential_scope.description: The scope of the credential used by the pipeline to authenticate to the artifact registry. Indicates whether the token/credential is scoped to specific repositories or granted broad/admin-level access.

pipeline_uses_dedicated_service_identity.title: Pipeline Uses Dedicated Service Identity
pipeline_uses_dedicated_service_identity.description: Whether the pipeline authenticates to the registry using a dedicated, pipeline-specific service identity (e.g., a robot account, workload identity, or OIDC-bound service account) rather than a shared, personal, or admin credential.

token_max_lifetime_seconds.title: Bearer Token Maximum Lifetime (Seconds)
token_max_lifetime_seconds.description: The maximum expiry window configured for bearer tokens issued for registry push operations. Longer lifetimes increase the replay attack window. A value above 300 seconds (5 minutes) is considered excessive for ephemeral push operations.

token_binding_enforced.title: Token Binding or Nonce Binding Enforced
token_binding_enforced.description: Whether the bearer tokens used for registry push are bound to the TLS session, a nonce, or a specific client context (e.g., via DPoP, nonce claim, or TLS token binding) to prevent replay by a different client.

signature_presence_enforced_at_ingestion.title: Signature Presence Enforced at Registry Ingestion
signature_presence_enforced_at_ingestion.description: Whether the artifact registry or admission policy rejects artifacts that arrive without an attached or associated cryptographic signature, ensuring that selectively dropped signature requests result in upload failure rather than silent acceptance.

sbom_upload_mechanism.title: SBOM Upload Mechanism
sbom_upload_mechanism.description: How the SBOM is transmitted to the registry relative to the primary artifact — as a separate HTTP request, as an OCI referrer attachment in the same manifest push, or not uploaded at all.

registry_sbom_presence_required.title: Registry SBOM Presence Required at Ingestion
registry_sbom_presence_required.description: Whether the registry or downstream admission control enforces that an SBOM must be present and associated with an artifact before it is accepted or promoted, preventing silent inventory gaps from dropped SBOM requests.

push_digest_verification_enabled.title: Push Digest Verification Enabled
push_digest_verification_enabled.description: Whether the pipeline verifies that the content-addressable digest returned by the registry after a push matches the locally computed digest before marking the build successful.

post_push_signature_verification_enabled.title: Post-Push Signature Verification Enabled
post_push_signature_verification_enabled.description: Whether the pipeline performs a cryptographic signature verification of the artifact after push (e.g., using Cosign verify or Notary) to confirm the registry stored exactly the signed artifact and that it was received by the legitimate registry.

push_rate_limit_enabled.title: Artifact Push Rate Limiting Enabled
push_rate_limit_enabled.description: Whether the registry endpoint enforces rate limits on artifact push (write) operations per service identity or credential.

push_anomaly_alerting_enabled.title: High-Velocity Push Anomaly Alerting Enabled
push_anomaly_alerting_enabled.description: Whether automated alerting or detection rules exist to flag abnormal volumes or frequencies of artifact push operations from pipeline service identities.

tag_overwrite_policy.title: Tag Overwrite Policy
tag_overwrite_policy.description: Whether the registry allows mutable tags (unrestricted overwrite), restricts overwrites, or enforces immutable tags on artifact push.

dnssec_validation_enabled.title: DNSSEC Validation Enabled
dnssec_validation_enabled.description: Whether the pipeline's DNS resolver enforces DNSSEC validation for registry hostname resolution, preventing acceptance of unsigned or tampered DNS responses.

registry_tls_certificate_pinning_enforce.title: Registry TLS Certificate Pinning Enforced
registry_tls_certificate_pinning_enforce.description: Whether the pipeline client pins the TLS certificate or CA for the container registry, preventing acceptance of certificates issued by a rogue CA during a DNS redirect.
